items.summary: feat(ui): queue session renames and reactions while the Gateway reconnects (#177558) * feat(ui): queue session metadata and reactions while reconnecting Keep unsent display assignments and reactions with the admitted Gateway identity, coalesce each key at the tail, and include them in connection status. Reconcile optimistic state and surface replay failures without replaying in-flight work. Keep the queue memory-only with reload protection. * fix(ui): keep queued offline changes through same-identity reconnects Bind queued work and optimistic presentation to credential and recovery identity rather than transport instances. Keep newer assignments ordered until the deferred drain settles, without replaying in-flight requests. * fix(ui): preserve reconnect lifecycle in the deferred outbox Keep old-client deletion and roster retirement while retaining queued metadata for the same credential scope. Avoid empty-queue snapshot publications during credential retirement, retain unadmitted rename drafts, and complete the existing test fixtures and browser contract. * style(agents): normalize node media result formatting Carry the formatting-only correction already landed on main in d3d368b1e0298486bfe06cb7d7b4e52e3c329542 (#177575) into this reviewed PR head so its exact-head CI can pass normally.

items.title: Microchip為NVMe SSD控制器導入CNSA 2.0後量子密碼學支援
items.summary: 晶片供應商Microchip於10月12日宣布擴充資料中心產品組合，為Flashtec SSD控制器引進後量子密碼學支援，並推出強化安全性功能的Switchtec PCIe 6.0交換器，更新Flashtec SSD控制器及Adaptec SmartRAID 4300系列NVMe RAID儲存加速器，因應AI資料中心對連線效能、儲存容量

items.title: 162個M365租戶遭未授權存取，ConnectWise備份API憑證遭濫用
items.summary: 資安業者Huntress於10月16日揭露，ConnectWise Cloud Backup的Microsoft 365應用程式憑證遭到濫用，攻擊者藉此未經授權登入162個Microsoft 365租戶。

items.title: Adobe於10月上半修補176個資安漏洞
items.summary: 10月13日Adobe發布本月上半的例行更新，為11種應用程式及系統元件推出修補程式，總共修補了176個資安漏洞。

items.title: AI發展與普及速度受制於安全性不足，SailPoint創辦人呼籲整個產業持續投入並付諸行動
items.summary: 近期頂尖AI模型服務失控事件引發關注，日前造訪香港的SailPoint執行長暨創辦人Mark McClain表示，AI不會也不該停下發展的腳步，關鍵在於設法提升AI安全性。他也談到該公司提倡的適應性身分，這是為了因應動態環境即時處理需求而發展的身分防護機制。最後，為了讓大家理解AI與安全性之間的關係，他特別用F1賽車為喻，指出煞車是否完善，是影響跑車能否發揮速度的關鍵，AI也是如此。

items.title: Adobe Commerce重大漏洞BlockStrap恐讓攻擊者直接在伺服器執行任意程式碼
items.summary: 上週Adobe修補Adobe Commerce（Magento Open Source）一系列資安漏洞，其中包含CVSS嚴重程度達到滿分10分的CVE-2026-103849。
